## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2021-08-18: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.4 to the 8-K announcing the Aldel/Hagerty Business Combination Agreement
- 2021-12-02: Executed TRA dated as of business combination close, 85% of cash tax savings to Hagerty Holding Corp. and Markel Group as Legacy Unit Holders
- 2021-12-08: 8-K reports the close and attaches the executed TRA

#### Amendment No. 1 (administrative-protective)

- 2023-06-23: Amendment No. 1 dated alongside the Fifth A&R LLC Agreement of THG; updates the Company Agreement reference and expands the Material Breach carve-outs in Section 4.1(f)(ii) so payment defaults attributable to insufficient THG distributions or credit-agreement limits do not constitute Material Breaches

#### Substantive accrual phase

- 2025-11: Q3 2025 10-Q records the first material TRA liability ($39.8M expected at YE2025) following the contemporaneous HHC exchange of 9,481,750 THG units and recognition of prior exchanges
- 2026-02-26: FY2025 10-K confirms TRA liability of $39.8M, $32.2M expense in 2025, and $0.2M of payments to Legacy Unit Holders during 2025

## Explanation

Hagerty, Inc. emerged from the December 2021 SPAC business combination of Aldel Financial Inc. and The Hagerty Group, LLC; at closing it executed an Up-C Tax Receivable Agreement obligating the public company to pay 85% of the cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups (on THG unit exchanges) to Hagerty Holding Corp. and Markel Group. The contract ran with one administrative-protective amendment in June 2023, which adjusted the Material Breach trigger to accommodate the new Series A preferred capital structure and credit-agreement limits without altering the payment percentage or beneficiary roster. Hagerty maintained a full valuation allowance through 2024, leaving the recognized liability small. In Q3 2025 the firm released the valuation allowance for both contemporaneous and historical exchanges, lifting the liability to $39.8M at YE2025 and producing the first cash payments under the contract ($0.2M). The TRA is in force as of the May 2026 cutoff. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
